subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should OpenClaw make chat.send ACK imply durable or actively-progressing WebChat user-turn persistence for this issue, or keep runtime-owned delayed persistence and track only UI/context mitigations?
rationale: The source shows partial UI/idempotency mitigations, but the remaining durable send boundary affects latency, duplicate suppression, session rollover, and runtime-owned transcript persistence, so maintainer intent is needed before a new fix lane or close decision.

options.title: Keep Open And Review Durable Send Contract
options.body: Use #95566 with #86946 and PR #80670 to decide or port the gateway recorder boundary, then close only with current-main proof across UI, history, transcript, and context.

options.title: Fold Into Umbrella Only
options.body: Close or demote this child under #69208 if maintainers decide the unique WebChat visual-order symptom no longer needs separate proof.

options.title: Limit To UI Reconciliation
options.body: Treat remaining work as a Control UI ordering/history fix only, accepting that durable transcript timing and context duplication are owned by other issues.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Review Durable Send Contract
recommendation.body: Use #95566 with #86946 and PR #80670 to decide or port the gateway recorder boundary, then close only with current-main proof across UI, history, transcript, and context.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the shared user-turn recorder and gateway persistence boundary introduced in their merged history.
